policy: Prefer official primary sources. Store source URLs and metadata; capture bytes only when permitted. Verify effective dates and current status per source. No entry here establishes a complete corpus.

sources.title: U.S. Constitution
sources.role: constitutional text and annotated constitutional analysis
sources.note: Annotations are secondary explanation; distinguish constitutional text from editorial analysis.

sources.title: United States Code
sources.note: GovInfo explains positive-law titles are legal evidence; for non-positive-law titles, Statutes at Large remain controlling evidence. Verify source and edition.

sources.title: Office of the Law Revision Counsel — U.S. Code
sources.note: Track annual supplements and source notes.

sources.title: Code of Federal Regulations
sources.role: annual CFR editions and regulatory research
sources.note: CFR annual volumes are staggered by title; use Federal Register for promulgation and amendment history.

sources.title: Electronic Code of Federal Regulations
sources.note: Useful current research view; GovInfo notes eCFR is not the official legal edition. Verify against Federal Register and official CFR editions.

sources.title: Federal Register
sources.role: proposed and final federal agency rules, notices and presidential documents
sources.note: Capture publication date, effective date, agency, docket and CFR amendments.

sources.title: Congress.gov
sources.role: bills, public laws, legislative actions and selected history
sources.note: A bill is not enacted law; preserve bill version and enactment status.

sources.title: U.S. Supreme Court opinions
sources.note: Capture slip opinion, docket, decision date, later corrections and subsequent treatment.

sources.title: United States Courts
sources.role: federal judiciary, court rules and court-system resources
sources.note: Court opinions and local rules may be distributed by individual courts.

sources.title: Arizona Constitution
sources.note: Record amendment history and effective dates.

sources.title: Arizona Revised Statutes
sources.note: Arizona Legislature says its online compilation reflects law effective January 1 following the latest session and is maintained primarily for legislative drafting; official version is published by Thomson Reuters. Verify historical versions and session laws.

sources.title: Arizona Legislature session laws and bills
sources.role: enacted legislation and legislative history discovery
sources.note: Confirm enactment, chapter number, effective date and codification.

sources.title: Arizona Administrative Code
sources.note: Capture register history, rulemaking docket and effective date.

sources.title: Arizona Courts — Sources of Law
sources.role: official guide to Arizona and federal legal source families
sources.note: Guide distinguishes constitutions, statutes, CFR/AAC, court rules and published opinions; Arizona is in Ninth Circuit.

sources.title: Arizona Supreme Court opinions
sources.note: Verify publication status and precedential treatment.

sources.title: Arizona Court Rules
sources.note: Identify court and case-type applicability; record amendment/effective dates.

sources.title: Arizona Court of Appeals opinions
sources.note: Capture division, publication designation, decision date and later treatment.
